Options for `navigator.credentials.create()`.

## Encoding

The `challenge` field contains 32 cryptographically random bytes encoded as
a **base64url string** (RFC 4648 Section 5, no padding). The BFF must decode
this to a raw `ArrayBuffer` before passing it to the WebAuthn browser API.

The `challenge_token` is a server-signed opaque token. Store it in the BFF
session and send it back verbatim with the verify request. Do not decode or
inspect it.

All binary fields in `excludeCredentials` and `user.id` are also base64url-encoded.

post.description: Search the authenticated user's reactions across all types with pagination and filtering. Filter by interaction_type, subject_guid, subject_type, or any combination.

schema.description: Choose one pagination family per request: `first`/`after` for forward cursor pagination, `last`/`before` for backward cursor pagination, `page`/`page_size` for page-based pagination, or `limit`/`offset` for offset pagination. If you omit pagination params, this schema defaults to `offset` pagination with a default size of 20.

after.description: Cursor pagination: return items after this cursor.

before.description: Cursor pagination: return items before this cursor.

filters.description: List of filters representing filter operations on specific fields. Filters are applied in the order they are defined.

first.description: Cursor pagination: number of items to return from the start.

last.description: Cursor pagination: number of items to return from the end.

limit.description: Offset pagination: maximum number of items to return. Defaults to the schema default limit.

order_by.description: Fields to order by. Optional because these endpoints define a default order; include to override it.

order_directions.description: Order directions applied to order_by. Missing entries default to ascending.

page_size.description: Page pagination: number of items per page.

data.description: A current user interaction on a discoverable resource

subject_type.description: Auto-populated type prefix from the GUID

data.title: ResourceInteraction

page_info.description: Pagination metadata. Some fields are only populated for specific pagination modes and are otherwise null.

current_offset.description: Current offset for offset or page pagination

current_page.description: Current page number for page or offset pagination

end_cursor.description: Cursor for the last item in the current cursor window

next_offset.description: Next offset for offset or page pagination

next_page.description: Next page number for page or offset pagination

page_size.description: Resolved page size or limit for the current result set

params.description: Original params captured on validation errors

previous_offset.description: Previous offset for offset or page pagination

previous_page.description: Previous page number for page or offset pagination

start_cursor.description: Cursor for the first item in the current cursor window

total_count.description: Total matching rows. Null for cursor pagination.

total_pages.description: Total pages for page or offset pagination
